dedupe_keys.name: canada energy regulator pipeline profiles throughput capacity safety tolls and financials

description: The Pipeline Profiles of the Canada Energy Regulator present key data and information for the major pipelines it regulates, covering pipeline use, safety and environment, tolls and financial information. On 2026-09-29 the application noted that data had been updated for the throughput and capacity and the safety and environment sections. Throughput and capacity series show how fully each system is used, while the safety sections draw on incidents reported to the regulator, and the toll and financial sections summarise regulated charges and company finances. Coverage: federally regulated oil and gas pipeline systems in Canada. Format and access: an interactive web application without registration. Licence and cost: free; the application page does not state a licence. Caveats: the profiles summarise company filings, cover only CER-regulated systems and give no network geometry. The throughput and capacity data support capacity planning and flow studies of pipeline networks, for example when a line is shut. It relates to the CER pipeline incident data and the US National Pipeline Mapping System in the catalogue.
